name: Kuromon Renji
source:
President of the 'Yomi' Shinigami company.
He raised the protagonist and considers her important.
A kind of god of pestilence that gives bad luck to any humans that get close to him.
A stoic guy who doesn't show much interest in things other than the protagonist.
